text:
Thanks, Olivia. Your 2023 Kestrel has one open recall: NM-26R02, hood latch may not hold in the secondary position. The remedy is replacing the hood latch, and parts are available. This is a safety recall, and recall repairs are done at no cost to you.

I can book the recall. Which branch would you like: Oakville, Mississauga, Ottawa, Scarborough, Vaughan, Brampton, Etobicoke, Markham, Burlington, Richmond Hill, or Ajax?

I can't leave the aftermarket tune out of your record. It may matter to the technician looking at the check engine light, so I'm passing your request to a team member who can go over the engine concern with you.
